audit_source:
import json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from tools import partial_language_continuation as p
h=p.h
repo=Path.cwd()
out=repo/'experiments/diagnostics/H004-partial-language-continuation'
data,plan=p.verify(repo,out)
seed=p.seed_path(out,plan)
def coordinates(root, category):
 result=set()
 for path in (root/category).glob('*/*.json'):
  row=h.load(path); c=(row['arm'],row['cycle'])
  assert c not in result and path.parent.name==c[0] and int(path.stem)==c[1]
  result.add(c)
 return result
expected_seed={(a,n) for a,f in p.FRONTIERS.items() for n in range(1,f+1)}
expected_new={(a,n) for a,f in p.FRONTIERS.items() for n in range(f+1,21)}
old=coordinates(seed,'responses');new=coordinates(out,'responses');attempts=coordinates(out,'attempts')
assert old==expected_seed and not(old&new)
statuses={}
for arm,cycle in sorted(new):
 request,trace=p.render_arm(repo,out,arm,cycle,(data,plan))
 assert h.load(h.at(out,'requests',arm,cycle))==request
 assert h.load(h.at(out,'traces',arm,cycle))==trace
 receipt=p.read_terminal(out,arm,cycle)
 statuses[receipt['status']]=statuses.get(receipt['status'],0)+1
provider=set()
for root in (seed,out):
 for path in (root/'provider').glob('*/*/call-*.request.json'):
  row=h.load(path)['coordinate'];c=(row['arm'],row['cycle'])
  assert c not in provider
  provider.add(c)
expected_trees={'src':'fbfb243fb21a8f7b86357d01b859047321ec3c38','experiments/plans':'5c5a85c6182a5527389c83a17bd44a13eace6400','experiments/records':'e40e1b847b751d49cdc41f41230c8daba84af28b'}
checks={}
for name,expected in expected_trees.items():
 actual=h.git(repo,'rev-parse','HEAD:'+name).decode().strip()
 unchanged=subprocess.run(['git','diff','--quiet','HEAD','--',name],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).returncode==0
 untracked=h.git(repo,'ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard','-z','--',name)
 checks[name]=actual==expected and unchanged and not untracked
# Scan every tracked repository file plus all H004 files; never print matching values.
files={repo/x for x in h.git(repo,'ls-files','-z').decode().split('\0') if x}
files.update(x for x in out.rglob('*') if x.is_file())
patterns=[re.compile(rb'\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\b'),re.compile(rb'\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}\b'),re.compile(rb'\bgithub_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}\b')]
hits={}
for path in sorted(files):
 raw=path.read_bytes();n=sum(len(pattern.findall(raw)) for pattern in patterns)
 if n:hits[path.relative_to(repo).as_posix()]=n
result={'schema':'minireason.h004.final-custody-audit.v1','h004_terminal_receipts':len(new),'h004_attempt_markers':len(attempts),'combined_unique_coordinates':len(old|new),'combined_unique_provider_coordinates':len(provider),'pending_markers':len(attempts-new),'h004_status_counts':statuses,'canonical_request_and_trace_equality_checked':len(new),'protected_trees_unchanged':checks,'credential_pattern_matching_files_and_counts':hits,'credential_scan_files':len(files),'scope':'All tracked repository files plus H004 files. Mechanical custody audit; no semantic adjudication or provider request.'}
result['final_ready']=new==attempts==expected_new and provider==(expected_seed|expected_new) and not(attempts-new) and 'STOPPED' not in statuses and all(checks.values()) and not hits
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
assert result['final_ready']
